source.title: Specimen book from the Boston type foundry (1889), printed p. 274; PDF page 282, Internet Archive leaf 282
source.rights: 1889 US publication; public domain in the United States under the maximum 95-year term. Library of Congress scan hosted by Internet Archive; its recorded assessment says the Library is unaware of copyright restrictions. Metadata and page map are retained locally. No modern redraw was used.

recipe.notes: Reviewed native crop; preserve all engraving; exclude catalogue labels and prices. The complete light-ink trace defines the shared frame, preventing tonal clipping; both editions retain the same transform.

multitone.notes: Native crop and rendered proof review: these darker-paper pages use 130/165/185 levels to exclude scan grain and paper stains that enter at 210. The lightest retained trace matches the reviewed monochrome ink.

recipe.notes: Clearer matching Figgins1834 impression. Preserve canonical ID, PUA mapping and advance. Previous Boston1889 witness and classification are retained in figgins1834-quality-revisions.json.
